thread:
deploybot: Drafting dedicated cutover for customer Solstice -> cluster `solstice-dedicated-01` on 2026-08-12 23:00 UTC. Change window 23:00-01:00 UTC. Planned rollout: blue/green with staged traffic 10% -> 40% -> 100%. Target version: rwd-infer-v1.15.0. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/solstice-dedicated-cutover

maya: heads-up — KMS rotation for solstice-key is scheduled at 23:30 by default. That overlaps the middle of the window.

devin: ops flagged that earlier. We should either move cutover earlier or request ops to freeze rotation for this key. Moving customers is painful. prefer asking ops to hold.

andre: technical note: v1.15.0 adds fused-attn and a new allocator. Staging soak looked good but we saw one incident on an 80GB instance with GC spikes. Recommend tiny canary pinned to v1.14.9 for 10% traffic for 15m, then bump to v1.15.0 for 40% if stable.

tara: release notes drafted — tokenizer normalization fix, cache determinism, no model weight changes. QA did a 12k RPS soak on staging for 2h; p95 up ~3.8% but within tolerance.

lucas: propose rollout steps: warm 3m -> 10% 15m -> 40% 20m -> 100% 30m. Gates: p50 latency increase >25% vs baseline OR error rate >0.7% sustained for 5m OR mem RSS growth >15% in 10m.

lucas: prometheus gate snippets:

```
# p50 baseline compare
solstice_p50 = histogram_quantile(0.5, sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="solstice"}[5m])) by (le))
# error rate
solstice_err = sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="solstice",status!~"2.."}[5m])) / sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="solstice"}[5m]))
```

devin: add grafana alerts: p50 > baseline*1.25 for 5m -> page #eng-oncall + #support; error_rate > 0.007 for 5m -> page SRE. Also alert on container memory RSS > baseline*1.15 for 10m.

sre-bot: Routing policy note: create an automatic fallback to hosted-api tier if healthcheck fails during blue/green swap; prefer hosted-tier -> then rollback to previous pin.

andre: I'll create pins: canary_pin -> rwd-infer-v1.14.9, prod_pin -> rwd-infer-v1.15.0. That makes rollbacks fast.

ops-bot: Ops action: please confirm if you want KMS rotation suspended for solstice-key between 22:30-01:30 UTC. Reply with CONFIRM to proceed.

maya: confirmed with security — suspend KMS rotation for solstice-key during 22:30-01:30 UTC.

deploybot: Deploy job prepared. Preview command:

```
deployctl rollout --customer solstice --cluster solstice-dedicated-01 --version rwd-infer-v1.15.0 --canary-version rwd-infer-v1.14.9 --strategy blue-green --schedule "2026-08-12T23:00Z" --steps "3m:warm,15m:10%,20m:40%,30m:100%" --fallback hosted-api
```

lara: support will be on pager. I'll add the customer-facing note: "Planned inference runtime update; expect <5% p95 variance. Contact support if you observe degraded throughput or repeated errors." I'll post at T-60m.

tara: adding support runbook link to the deploy job and final release note.

andre: rollback playbook attached to deploy job. If any gate trips I'll hit the manual hold at 10% and revert to canary_pin rwd-infer-v1.14.9. Rollback triggers reiterated: p50 >25% up, error_rate >0.7% sustained 5m, mem RSS growth >15% 10m.

devin: prod & security ack from my side. :thumbsup:

sre-bot: oncall rotation confirms @andre as primary for 23:00-01:00 UTC. Auto-ack required in thread.

andre: ack — I am primary SRE and will monitor. I'll watch allocator churn and KV cache sizes closely.

deploybot: Final checklist: runbook linked, KMS hold confirmed, pins and fallback created, alerts configured, support on pager. Deploy ID: 91047. Scheduling queued for 2026-08-12T23:00Z.

maya: final compliance ack. No outstanding approvals.

tara: publishing T-60m customer note and support handoff.

deploybot: scheduled. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/solstice-dedicated-cutover | Deploy ID: 91047 | Thread locked: only SRE or release lead can update.

andre: locking it down. Good luck. :rocket:
